verification.notes: The Washington Post reports, based on messages it reviewed and an interview with the recipient, that Robinson sent his Wordle score to a friend at 11:28 a.m. on September 10, 2025. This supports the statement while leaving the pending criminal charges and responsibility for the shooting legally unadjudicated.
